div.div: Live on 24 November 2026: the org Public holds 16 dashboards (the landing page, 9 Platform, 6 MOKS); the 7 Jithendar.com dashboards stay in the main org. A Viewer may query every data source of its org, not only the dashboards' queries, so the org decides what is public.

text.tspan: Live on 24 November 2026: the org Public holds 16 dashboards (the landing page, 9 Platform, 6 MOKS); the 7 Jithendar.com dashboards stay in the main org. A Viewer may
query every data source of its org, not only the dashboards' queries, so the org decides what is public.
